authentication.description: Purchase credits via buy_credits tool (Bitcoin Lightning invoice). Pass API key as LIGHTNING_TOOLS_API_KEY env var or use set_api_key tool.

tools.name: buy_credits
tools.description: Purchase Lightning Tools credits via Bitcoin Lightning invoice. Costs N sats = N credits.

tools.name: verify_payment
tools.description: Confirm a Lightning payment and receive your API key.

tools.name: set_api_key
tools.description: Store an existing Lightning Tools API key and unlock all service tools.

apiKey.description: Your Lightning Tools API key (starts with sk_)

tools.name: check_balance
tools.description: Return the current credit balance for your active API key.

tools.name: email-validator
tools.description: Validates an email address and returns a comprehensive quality signal including syntax, DNS, MX, disposable check, role account detection, free provider detection, domain age, and a 0-1 quality score. Cost: 2 credits per call. Idempotency-Key header is recommended — use the same key to safely retry without being charged twice. Costs 2 credits per call.

tools.name: calculator
tools.description: Evaluates arithmetic, algebra, trigonometry, logarithms, unit conversions, and natural language math. Accepts mathjs syntax (e.g. 'sqrt(144)', 'log(100, 10)', '1 mile to km') or plain English (e.g. 'square root of 144', '15% of 340', '100 celsius to fahrenheit'). Cost: 1 credit per call. Idempotency-Key header is recommended — use the same key to safely retry without being charged twice. Costs 1 credit per call.

expression.description: A mathematical expression in mathjs syntax or plain English.

tools.name: qr-code
tools.description: Generates a QR code as a base64 PNG string or SVG string. Cost: 1 credit per call. Idempotency-Key header is recommended — use the same key to safely retry without being charged twice. Costs 1 credit per call.

content.description: Content to encode in the QR code

format.description: png returns a raw base64 string. svg returns an SVG string.

errorCorrectionLevel.description: L=7%, M=15%, Q=25%, H=30% data recovery capability

tools.name: extract-text
tools.description: Fetches a URL and extracts clean readable text using Mozilla Readability. Returns title, plain text, clean HTML, excerpt, byline, and word count. Text is cleaned of excess whitespace and HTML artefacts. All fields except url are nullable. Cost: 2 credits per call. Costs 2 credits per call.

url.description: The URL to fetch and extract content from.

tools.name: phone-validator
tools.description: Validates and parses a phone number using libphonenumber-js. Returns country, type (MOBILE/FIXED_LINE/VOIP/etc.), and formatted variants. Invalid numbers return valid:false with HTTP 200 — credits are still charged. Cost: 1 credit per call. Costs 1 credit per call.

phone.description: Phone number to validate. E.164 format preferred (e.g. +353861234567). National format accepted with country hint.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code hint for parsing national-format numbers (e.g. IE, US, GB)

tools.name: date-utils_today
tools.description: Returns the current date, day of week, UTC offset, DST status, working day status, week number, quarter, days until month/quarter end, next working day, and upcoming holidays. Cost: 1 credit. Costs 1 credit per call.

tools.name: date-utils_convert-time
tools.description: Converts an ISO 8601 datetime from one IANA timezone to another, including UTC offset and DST info. Cost: 1 credit. Costs 1 credit per call.

tools.name: date-utils_is-working-day
tools.description: Returns whether a date is a working day for a given country, including holiday details if not. Cost: 1 credit. Costs 1 credit per call.

tools.name: date-utils_next-working-day
tools.description: Finds the next (or previous) working day after a given date, skipping weekends and public holidays. Cost: 1 credit. Costs 1 credit per call.

tools.name: date-utils_add-working-days
tools.description: Adds N working days to a date (negative = backward), skipping weekends and public holidays. Cost: 1 credit. Costs 1 credit per call.

tools.name: date-utils_count-working-days
tools.description: Counts working days between start and end (inclusive), excluding weekends and public holidays. Cost: 1 credit. Costs 1 credit per call.

tools.name: date-utils_meeting-windows
tools.description: Returns working day availability for 2-5 countries over a date range (max 90 days), identifying days when all countries are simultaneously available. Cost: 2 credits. Costs 2 credits per call.

tools.name: date-utils_timezone-overlap
tools.description: Finds the UTC window where all specified timezones are simultaneously within working hours. Cost: 1 credit. Costs 1 credit per call.
